upstreamDescription: Provides instructions and workflows for accessing and managing hardware on Android XR projected devices, such as audio glasses and display glasses. Use this skill when building experiences for intelligent eyewear in an Android app and you need to access device hardware like the camera and microphone, handle glasses-specific runtime permissions, or manage connection lifecycles using projected context.
